obs_44eab5c79699423a832818c37648d4bf.summary:
Receiver-owned capability-development need: Develop rough-transport cart designs with a method another lab published
Desired acceptance: Beats the fixed cart by one success on twelve fresh public instances
An exact network method selection is retained as evidence (fc30206d62608928c7953bb95cdcf72fdfa8bbe8fac3ad1e8e026f605284fb05). It is not an installed Actor capability or an accepted method. Assess continuing responsibility using the existing owners; create a specialist only when distinct continuing work justifies it. Availability alone requires no organizational change.

req_280b075fc8db45959c7dc6a1bb92ae0e.acceptance: The developed cart design achieves at least one more success than the fixed cart on twelve fresh public instances.
